notablePrerequisites: You control a basic land that can produce {W}.
description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W}.
When you cast Whitemane Lion, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token with vigilance.
Resolve Whitemane Lion.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers.
In response, activate Earthcraft by tapping Whitemane Lion, untapping a basic land you control that can produce {W}.
Resolve Whitemane Lion's ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite Warrior tokens, you may activate Earthcraft any number of times.
